links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT (ChatGPTd) relying on training knowledge alone
links.outcome: Composite expert-rated score (appropriateness, accuracy, relevance, clarity, clinical utility) for complex interventional cardiology cases
links.effect: ChatGPT with ESC guidelines (ChatGPT-gl) 7.7 (95% CI 7.4-7.9) vs default ChatGPT 6.9 (6.6-7.3); differences across LLMs P<.001 and consistent across all scoring dimensions
links.quote: Performance significantly varied across LLMs (P less than .001), with ChatGPTi (7.8 [7.5-8.0]) and ChatGPT-gl (7.7 [7.4-7.9]) outperforming others.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (guidelines or web search) added to an existing LLM
